title: Mustangs Host First Night Game
description: For the first time in school history, Marlboro High School hosted a football game under the lights. Without permanent stadium lighting, the school went all in, renting ten towering construction lights to surround the field and turn night into day.

title: Mustangs Stampede Into Playoffs
description: Marlboro defeats Washington Township 21-17 to advance to the second round of the NJSIAA Group 5 playoffs.  It was the first time Marlboro had qualified for the playoffs since 1999, and the first playoff victory since 1994.
alt: Picture of number 7 Ryan Mendes with football

title: History Made in Marlboro
description: Marlboro defeats South Brunswick 26-16 to advance to the second round of the NJSIAA Group 5 playoffs.  Marlboro made the playoffs in back to back seasons for the first time in school history.  The team would advance to the NJSIAA South Jersey Group 5 Sectional 5 where they would lose in double overtime.
alt: Picture of number 22 Matt Cassidy with Marlboro football coach Jason Dagato
